scripts.build:release: node scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-landing.mjs --source && vite build && node scripts/prepare-release.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && node scripts/check-landing.mjs --dist && npm run test:rendered
scripts.cloudflare:dry-run: npm run check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging
scripts.cloudflare:deploy:staging: npm run build:release && node scripts/check-landing.mjs --dist && npm run test:rendered && wrangler deploy --env staging && npm run test:deployed
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run build:release && node scripts/check-landing.mjs --dist && npm run test:rendered && wrangler deploy
